class_size_limits_001.evidence: The Board will make a conscientious effort to guarantee that no self-contained elementary class will exceed the number of students per classroom proposed in the current budget... In the event of a dispute over this Article, the parties will meet in a good faith effort to resolve it.

class_overage_remedy_004.evidence: If any class exceeds these numbers, every effort will be made to provide a paraeducator for that teacher.
